source.publication: 2025 Form 80-100 Resident, Non-Resident and Part-Year Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (Rev. 12/25) and the 2025 Form 80-105 Resident Return (Rev. 09/25)
source.section: Form 80-105 page 1 lines 8-17 and page 2 lines 38-66; Instructions PDF p.5 Filing Status and Exemptions table; p.6 Additional Exemptions, Lines 8-12; p.7 Lines 14-17; p.22 Tax Rates; p.27 Schedule of Tax Computation lines 1-4; Instructions PDF p.6 Line 4 Head of Family

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - 23,625.00 federal standard deduction = 16,375.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 80-105 filing status box 4, Head of Family. Start at federal AGI 40,000.00 (Mississippi builds its own income on lines 38 to 66; the projection starts from federal AGI and takes out the exempt income, the same result here). Line 66 and line 13 Mississippi AGI = 40,000.00. Line 14 standard deduction 3,400.00. Line 8 age boxes checked 0; line 10 = 0 x 1,500.00 = 0.00; line 11 8,000.00; line 12 and line 15 = 8,000.00. Line 16 Mississippi taxable income = 40,000.00 - 3,400.00 - 8,000.00 = 28,600.00. Schedule of Tax Computation line 1: first 10,000.00 x 0% = 0.00; line 2: remaining 18,600.00 x 4.4% = 818.40; line 4 and line 17 = 818.40. Lines 18 and 19 credits 0.00; line 20 = 818.40. The form rounds to whole dollars (p.22), which would give 818; expected keeps the formula result. The return also allows 1,500 for the required dependent on line 10 (9,500 in all): taxable 27,100.00, tax 752.40, which is 66.00 less. The projection does not model the dependent exemption, and expected follows the projection.
accepted_approximations: Mississippi builds its own income (Form 80-105 lines 38 to 66); the projection starts from federal AGI and removes the exempt income through the reliefs and Social Security treatment.
Dependent exemption of 1,500 each. A head of family always has one (8,000 plus 1,500 for the required dependent), so that status is 66 a year too high here.
